# web_search_response

web_search response — describes the JSON structure returned by the OpenAI web_search tool, including the list of result objects and their fields for citation.

## Top‑level structure
```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "title": "...",
      "url": "...",
      "snippet": "..."
    },
    ...
  ]
}
```
- **results**: an array of up to 10 (or service‑defined) result objects, ordered by relevance.

## Result object fields
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| title | string | Human‑readable page title, typical length ≤ 120 characters. |
| url   | string | Fully qualified URL (including scheme). |
| snippet | string | A short excerpt (≈ 200 characters) from the page that matches the query. |

## Optional metadata (future‑proof)
Some deployments may include additional keys such as `published_date` or `source`.

## Access patterns
- The model should iterate over `results` and select the most relevant entry for citation.
- When no results are found, `results` will be an empty array.
